rows.grounds: evāntaraṃ = indeed inner (neuter nominative singular of compound)
kiṃciddhīsaṃjñaṃ = something called intellect (neuter nominative singular of bahuvrīhi/tatpuruṣa-type compound)
bhavatu = let there be (third person singular imperative active)
yatrāsya = where for this (yatra indeclinable + asya genitive singular of idam; given as single token)
saṃkalpasvapnadarśane = in imagination and dream-seeing (neuter locative singular of dvandva/tatpuruṣa compound)
